text:
sre_lead: kicking off first-touch for the blueregion account (az-bluepeak). goal: get cloud project, vnet, and GPU quota into a state we can hand off to infra-oncall. timeline: 2-3 business days unless quota/peering blocks.
sre_lead: high level checklist: 1) create project & billing link 2) reserve CIDR 3) setup shared VPC + subnets 4) request GPU quotas (A100/T4) 5) service account + keyplan 6) baseline firewall + bastion.
netops_maria: copying checklist to thread, will start CIDR proposal. suggest we avoid 10.0/8 overlaps — customer infra often uses that. thinking /16 contiguous for region: `10.240.0.0/16` for spine, `10.241.0.0/16` for app subnets? :thinking_face:
infra_jamal: prefer smaller blocks for isolates: spine /20, compute pools /18, infra /20. rough layout i used recently:```
spine: 10.240.0.0/20
compute-gpu: 10.240.16.0/18
infra-services: 10.241.0.0/20
bastion: 10.241.16.0/24
```
cloud_ops_ben: FYI quota requests can take 24-72h. i'll file the OEM GPU quota (A100-40GB) request after project exists. also need to validate regional availability: azure zone AZ-B has limited A100s right now.
netops_maria: good call — opening a capacity note: "AZ-B current A100 stock low" and tagging sku owners. :eyes:
security_ana: reminder: customer requires CMEK + restricted egress for this project. we'll need KMS key created and IAM roles locked down before handoff.
sre_lead: placing initial tasks: 1) @cloud_ops_ben create project + billing; 2) @netops_maria CIDR + shared VPC draft; 3) @infra_jamal terraform scaffold for kosmos-gpu-cluster; 4) @security_ana CMEK + network policy template.
cloud_ops_ben: done — project created `redwood-blueregion-prod` and billing linked. deploy-bot: created ticket INFRA-4319.
deploy-bot: Ticket INFRA-4319 created: "blueregion project provisioning" assigned to cloud_ops_ben, netops_maria, infra_jamal. link: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-4319
infra_jamal: pushing initial terraform module to `gitlab/infrastructure/regions/blueregion` — PR up: MR !24. contains vpc + subnet modules and initial nodepool tfvars. paste of the key snippet:```
module "vpc" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@gitlab.internal/infrastructure/modules/vpc.git"
  project = "redwood-blueregion-prod"
  cidr_block = "10.240.0.0/16"
}
```
netops_maria: quick validation checklist before we request peering: 1) no overlapping cidrs, 2) route table for prefix /0 to nat-gw, 3) hub transit tested, 4) private DNS zone wired.
cloud_ops_ben: filed GPU quota request with cloud provider: request id Q-99827. estimated approval 48h. attached the quota email as comment on INFRA-4319.
security_ana: for CMEK i'll need the KMS key ARN and the service account that will own it. also please add the audit logging retention to 365d per compliance.
sre_lead: question on cost: if we reserve dedicated capacity for this region we'll pay baseline commit. is there appetite to start with burstable until usage is stable?
infra_jamal: i'd start with on-demand / preemptible mixes: 60% preemptible T4 for batch, 40% reserved A100 for latency-critical. saves a lot while we validate load.
netops_maria: note: some customers insist on no preemptibles in production — flag this on the account.
sre_lead: noted, we'll put an opt-out flag on account config.
cloud_ops_ben: once quotas approved i'll spin up a small smoke cluster (2 A100 nodes) and run the short smoke script: `./scripts/smoke-gpu.sh blueregion` — will post results here.
deploy-bot: INFRA-4319 updated: comment added by cloud_ops_ben with quota request id Q-99827.
netops_maria: preflight done for CIDR, no overlap with existing regions. posting peering req tomorrow AM.
infra_jamal: MR !24 merged. terraform apply scheduled in staging: `apply --auto-approve` at 2024-06-18T03:00Z — leaving outputs for subnet ids and route table.
sre_lead: once smoke passes, we'll run the handoff checklist and assign oncall rotation. expected handoff window: Wed afternoon.
cloud_ops_ben: smoke run complete: logs show GPU drivers installed, KV cache test passed, latency baseline ~12ms for local inference. attaching truncated logs:```
[INFO] driver: nvidia 530.30 loaded
[INFO] kata-run: container started
[INFO] kvcache: warm-up complete in 3.2s
[WARN] preemptible-spot flapping observed x3
```
netops_maria: saw the spot flapping too, likely AZ-B capacity churn. recommend pinning nodepools to AZ-A for now.
security_ana: CMEK key created: `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/blueregion/cryptoKeys/blueregion-key`. added IAM principals to INFRA-SA and logging service accounts.
sre_lead: looks like everything is green besides AZ capacity note. next steps: 1) lock nodepool AZ to AZ-A, 2) confirm quotas fully approved, 3) run full e2e smoke (tokenized prompts, 10k tokens), 4) handoff to infra-oncall. anyone object?
infra_jamal: no objections.
cloud_ops_ben: no objections.
netops_maria: all good.
security_ana: good from security.
sre_lead: great — assigning handoff on INFRA-4319 and closing the loop after e2e. :white_check_mark:
